https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/14/volodymyr-zelenskyy-feels-betrayed-by-donald-trump-over-starlink-access

Guardian. LD datePublished/Modified Thu 15 Oct 00:00 BST (filed under 14 Oct URL). By Dan Sabbagh, Jessica Elgot, Andrew Roth.
Headline: 'Volodymyr Zelenskyy feels betrayed by Donald Trump over Starlink access'.
Zelensky, asked in a TV interview whether the Starlink restriction was deliberate and whether he felt betrayed by Trump: 'Really, yes ... but it's a little bit more complicated than just my emotions or my feelings', adding: 'It's a pity that we are losing, we are losing a strong partner.'
Zelensky to Piers Morgan: 'I am sure they knew what they did, absolutely. Because it was 1am at night, Starlink was blocked by SpaceX and the United States.' / 'This decision will bring a lot of human losses ... of course, people will die.'
Elon Musk: 'Starshield systems are owned and controlled by the US government. Any limits on speed or usage are decided by the US military and ultimately POTUS.' Musk said the decision to curtail Starlink was not made by him.
Serhiy Beskrestnov, adviser on military technology to Zelensky (and military blogger): 'Our armed forces did not receive a warning about these restrictions and this led to the failure of a number of missions.' / 'It's clear that this action cannot be a coincidence and is connected to the current political situation.' / 'With their actions, our partners are depriving us of one of the few chances we have to defend ourselves.'
MECHANISM: terminals travelling above 100mph on the military/national-security version lost connectivity. Renders most deep-strike drones inoperable and hits the interceptors used against jet-powered Shahed drones. Shahed interception rates had already fallen from more than 90% to about 60% after Russia upgraded to jet engines in early summer.
CRITICAL CAVEAT (undercuts any single causal chain): 'it would have no impact on Ukraine's deep strike bombing of oil refineries because Kyiv is banned from using Starlink to hit targets inside of Russia.'
INTEL STRAND, kept distinct: Trump denied on Tuesday that his administration had cut intelligence sharing. Zelensky told NPR (aired Wednesday) that military advisers had received threats from the US that intelligence sharing could be limited in future.
Russian strike late Tuesday: 39 ballistic missiles and 120 attack drones at Kyiv and Kharkiv; hit five big power plants and key substations; at least 600,000 without power per Zelensky.
Dmitry Peskov, Kremlin spokesperson: 'The energy truce proposed by Trump was not specified in detail, so it cannot be claimed that Russia is failing to observe it.'
UK: PM Andy Burnham to Zelensky at No 10: 'You have seen the solidarity and the support you have got from everybody here in Britain. We are behind you and that will not change.' Burnham to accelerate supply of British lightweight multi-role missiles; UK to give GBP 17m towards repairs to the protective roof over Chornobyl. Zelensky met King Charles at Buckingham Palace. Meeting lasted just over an hour.
Guardian notes most analysts say the closure of the strait of Hormuz after the US-Israel attack on Iran had a far larger impact on energy prices than Ukrainian refinery strikes.
